title: Reduced cartesian compactification of a finite etale cover
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ a reduced separated finite-type curve of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting, def-pc-reduced-scheme], $j:U\to X$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion], and $v:V\to U$ finite etale [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism]. There exist a reduced scheme $Y$, a finite $p:Y\to X$, and an open immersion $a:V\to Y$, such that $f\circ p$ makes $Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-curve of dimension at most one and the square $(a,v,p,j)$ is cartesian [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square].

proof.text: Apply Zariski main theorem to j composed with v and replace the finite compactification by the reduced closure of V. Etale over reduced implies V reduced, so V remains a dense open in the reduced compactification Y. Finiteness gives the separated finite-type curve structure and the dimension bound by integral incomparability. The inclusion V -> p^{-1}(U) is finite by permanence over a separated scheme; hence its dense open image is closed and is all of p^{-1}(U). A surjective open immersion is an isomorphism, giving the cartesian square.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_reduced_cartesian_finite_cover_compactification
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X U V : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] [IsReduced X]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (v : V ⟶ U) [IsFinite v] [Etale v] :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (p : Y ⟶ X) (a : V ⟶ Y),
      IsFinite p ∧ IsCurve (p ≫ f) ∧ IsReduced Y ∧ IsOpenImmersion a ∧
        IsPullback a v p j
